name: @comchatx/openai
description: OpenAI in pi, through the ComChatX box's model proxy.
author: ComChatX

description.en:
GPT is OpenAI's model family. GPT-6 Sol is designed for reasoning over long documents and tables, while GPT-6 Luna prioritises speed and lower cost. Both can read images and files.

Choose Sol for long reports and multi-step instructions. Choose Luna for everyday questions and summaries.
description.zh:
GPT 是 OpenAI 的模型系列。GPT-6 Sol 适合分析长文档和表格；GPT-6 Luna 响应更快、价格更低。两者都能读取图片和文件。

长报告和多步骤任务可选 Sol；日常提问和摘要可选 Luna。
